01 / Treatment options

Treatment for pain.
A plan for better movement.

Tell us where it hurts and what feels difficult. Your assessment guides the choice of treatment.

01

Physiotherapy

Treatment for back, neck and knee pain, stiffness and movement problems.

Explore this treatment＋

Physiotherapy combines targeted exercise, movement advice and hands-on treatment to support pain relief, strength and mobility.

Concerns to discuss

Back pain, neck pain, knee pain, shoulder pain, sciatica and difficulty with everyday movement.

What to expect

An assessment of your symptoms, movement and strength, followed by a treatment plan and exercises to practise between visits.

Discuss physiotherapy ↗
02

Chiropractic

Hands-on care for back pain, neck pain and joint stiffness.

Explore this treatment＋

Chiropractic uses hands-on techniques to work on joint movement. For back pain, manual care is combined with exercise and movement advice.

Concerns to discuss

People with back pain, neck pain or stiffness who want to discuss hands-on treatment.

What to expect

A health-history and suitability check, an explanation of benefits and risks, and your consent before treatment.

Discuss chiropractic care ↗
03

Hijama

Wet cupping with a suitability check and clear aftercare.

Explore this treatment＋

Hijama is wet cupping. Evidence for pain relief is limited; it is not a replacement for medical assessment.

Concerns to discuss

People who want to discuss cupping with a practitioner. Medical history and medicines must be reviewed first.

What to expect

A suitability check, consent, hygiene precautions and aftercare guidance. Ask about bleeding, infection and other risks.

Discuss hijama ↗

Your assessment determines the treatment. Results vary.

02 / Your first visit

Know what comes next.

Discuss your symptoms, understand your treatment options and ask about fees before you begin.

  1. 01

    Assessment

    We discuss your concern, health history and the movements that feel difficult.

  2. 02

    Your plan

    Your physiotherapist explains the treatment options, expected session plan and exercises for home.

  3. 03

    Your sessions

    Treatment and movement guidance are adapted to your needs and response.

  4. 04

    Follow-up

    Review your progress, ask questions and adjust the plan together.
